question: schools under-delivering on applications - received less than 50 percent of what was expected, loose name matching (each application should count towards only its single best matching school)
gold_sql: WITH best AS (SELECT a."Applicant" AS applicant, o."School Name" AS matched_school, jaro_winkler_similarity(lower(trim(a."School")), lower(trim(o."School Name"))) AS sim FROM lpf_applications AS a JOIN lpf_outreach AS o ON jaro_winkler_similarity(lower(trim(a."School")), lower(trim(o."School Name"))) >= 0.9 QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a."Applicant" ORDER BY sim DESC, o."School Name") = 1) SELECT o."School Name", COUNT(b.applicant) AS applications_received, o."Applications Expected" FROM lpf_outreach AS o LEFT JOIN best AS b ON b.matched_school = o."School Name" GROUP BY o."School Name", o."Applications Expected" HAVING COUNT(b.applicant) < o."Applications Expected" / 2.0 ORDER BY o."School Name"

You translate ordinary questions into exactly one read-only DuckDB SELECT or WITH query.

Return SQL only. Never write files, install software, calculate values yourself, or invent columns.

Use only the supplied schema. Preserve relevant scope from earlier turns unless the newest question changes it.

A requested rate must use its stated numerator and denominator. Percentage-point change means later percentage minus earlier percentage, not relative growth.

When the user explicitly asks for percent or percentage, multiply numerator divided by denominator by 100.

When the user asks to compare years or groups without asking for a change, keep those year/group columns and requested measures in the output.

When several known category values are named, filter them separately with IN rather than concatenating them.

Use NULLIF for denominators. Missing values remain missing and are not zero.

Quote column names with double quotes when they contain spaces or odd characters. When two tables describe the same thing with different column names, UNION ALL them with aligned aliases.

For approximate name matching across tables use jaro_winkler_similarity(lower(trim(a)), lower(trim(b))) >= 0.9, keep only the single best match per row (QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY row ORDER BY similarity DESC) = 1), then LEFT JOIN from the reference table so rows with zero matches are kept.

schools under-delivering on applications - received less than 50 percent of what was expected, loose name matching (each application should count towards only its single best matching school)
attempts.response:
WITH matched AS (
  SELECT 
    o."School Name" AS school,
    o."Block",
    o."Students Reached",
    o."Applications Expected",
    o."Contact Teacher",
    o."Date",
    a."Applicant",
    a."Course",
    a."Status",
    a."Marks"
  FROM "lpf_outreach" o
  LEFT JOIN "lpf_applications" a ON 
    jaro_winkler_similarity(lower(trim(o."School Name")), lower(trim(a."School"))) >= 0.9
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a."Applicant" ORDER BY jaro_winkler_similarity(lower(trim(o."School Name")), lower(trim(a."School"))) DESC) = 1
)
SELECT 
  school,
  "Block",
  SUM("Students Reached") AS total_reached,
  SUM("Applications Expected") AS total_expected,
  SUM(CASE WHEN "Status" = 'Submitted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_submitted,
  SUM(CASE WHEN "Status" = 'Verified' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_verified,
  SUM(CASE WHEN "Status" = 'Rejected' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_rejected,
  SUM(CASE WHEN "Status" = 'Incomplete' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_incomplete,
  SUM(CASE WHEN "Status" = 'Submitted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM("Applications Expected"), 0) AS submission_rate_pct,
  SUM(CASE WHEN "Status" = 'Verified' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM("Applications Expected"), 0) AS verification_rate_pct
FROM matched
GROUP BY school, "Block"
HAVING SUM("Applications Expected") > 0 
   AND SUM(CASE WHEN "Status" = 'Submitted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM("Applications Expected"), 0) < 50
ORDER BY school;
